title: 2017 Toyota Camry XSE Hood Repaint and Grille Replacement
summary: 2017 Toyota Camry XSE front-end refinish, including a repainted hood and new front grille replacement at Carcis Autobody Repair.
story: A 2017 Toyota Camry XSE came to the shop requiring front-end body work focused on the hood and grille. The team repainted the hood and installed a replacement front grille assembly to restore the vehicle's finish and styling.

Proper prep work is essential when repainting a metal hood panel. The surface is sanded, primed, and prepared before applying basecoat and clearcoat inside the spray booth. Technicians ensure the fresh black paint matches the surrounding bodywork. Replacing the grille requires removing damaged trim pieces and installing the new factory-style grille into the front bumper assembly with proper alignment.
